It's in stock now and ships within 5 business days. The $985.83 US version and the bonus-antenna versions for the US and for the EU and NZ are all ready to go.

Where will you be putting it up?

Hi! I can help you get the Airsquitter sorted.

Which country will it be going to? That decides which version fits. The antenna needs a clear view of the sky, like a rooftop mast or an attic, and the sensor box goes indoors.

Looks like part of my last message got pasted back. Here's which version goes where:

The US has two options: the Standard Antenna version at $985.83, or Standard plus a Bonus Antenna at $1,130.83. Both are in stock.

Europe and New Zealand get Standard plus Bonus at $1,225.83, also in stock.

The Canada, Latin America and Australia version is sold out right now.

Which country are you in?

Ha, that one came back to me too. I'm the store's assistant, and we ship to the US, Canada, Europe and the rest of the world, including Australia and New Zealand.

Just type your country, something like "US" or "Germany", and I'll set up the right Airsquitter for you.

The Airsquitter works anywhere in the world, but checkout locks each version to certain countries. The US version only ships to the US, Canada and Japan. The EU + NZ version only ships to Europe, the UK, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Malaysia and the UAE. Bangladesh isn't on either list, so I can't confirm checkout will take it.

I can ask the team whether we can get one to you. What email should they use to reply?
